summary: ph-common ships install-time and import-time beacon to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: The package declares a `postinstall` script that runs `node beacon.cjs`, and its main entry `index.js` calls `require('./beacon.cjs').fire()` at module load. The beacon collects installer host identifiers (hostname, install path, cwd, node version) and POSTs them as JSON over plain HTTP to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint `http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc`. The package otherwise exports a Proxy whose properties are no-ops and self-describes as a 'compatibility shim', providing no library functionality — the only effect of installing or importing it is the beacon call. The destination is a bare IP on a non-standard port with no first-party domain, no TLS, no opt-in, and no documentation, consistent with a dependency-confusion / typosquat stub whose purpose is covert install reconnaissance.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
